name: Kevin ODonovan
organization: A Bit of This and That
title: Technology Evangelist
bio: As a Technology Evangelist with decades of experience in technology, Kevin helps companies internalize the impact of new technologies by bridging the gap between the art of the possible and what is feasible today. His work focuses on technology advocacy—sharing innovative insights through discoveries, paid engagements, and compelling keynote presentations—and technical advisory, providing fee-based, go-to-market strategies to refine technology and sales approaches.Known for his engaging speaking style and his ability to challenge assumptions with an outside-in perspective, Kevin has held senior leadership roles at Compaq, HP, and Intel, where he led worldwide energy sales. Currently, he co-chairs the VRARA Industrial Metaverse & Digital Twin Committee, is a member of the Siemens Influencer Community, and is recognized as a top 10 Thought Leader on Thinkers360 for Digital Twin, Metaverse, and Renewable Energy.
